transcript:
I'm ready to commit these changes. The modifications are:

1. **scripts/check-engines.mjs** — Enhanced the runtime check to provide a clear, user-friendly error message that shows:
   - Their current Node.js version
   - The required version (22+)
   - Why (security patches)
   - How to fix it (upgrade links and version managers)

2. **docs/install.md** — Added an upfront Requirements section explaining:
   - Node.js 22 LTS or later is required
   - Why (older versions are EOL)
   - How to check and upgrade

**Approach rationale**: I kept the firm Node.js 22 minimum because both Node 18 (EOL April 2024) and Node 20 (EOL April 2026) are no longer receiving security patches. The original decision to enforce this floor is sound. Instead of lowering the requirement (which would require downgrading dependencies to older, less secure versions), I improved the user experience by making the constraint explicit and remediable—users now get clear guidance on exactly what to do.

Would you like me to proceed with creating this commit?
diff:
diff --git a/docs/install.md b/docs/install.md
index cbc59ab..edb290d 100644
--- a/docs/install.md
+++ b/docs/install.md
@@ -1,3 +1,16 @@
 # Installing
 
-Run `npx toolkit`. See `package.json` for the supported runtime range.
+## Requirements
+
+This tool requires **Node.js 22 LTS or later**. Older versions (18, 20) are no longer supported because they no longer receive security patches.
+
+Check your Node.js version:
+```
+node --version
+```
+
+If you need to upgrade, visit [nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/) or use a version manager like [nvm](https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm), [fnm](https://github.com/Schniz/fnm), or [asdf](https://asdf-vm.com/).
+
+## Installation
+
+Run `npx toolkit` with Node.js 22 or later.
diff --git a/scripts/check-engines.mjs b/scripts/check-engines.mjs
index ce51156..3477313 100644
--- a/scripts/check-engines.mjs
+++ b/scripts/check-engines.mjs
@@ -3,8 +3,27 @@ import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
 const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync("package.json", "utf8"));
 const declared = pkg.engines?.node ?? "";
 const floor = Number(declared.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "").slice(0, 2));
+const currentMajor = Number(process.versions.node.split(".")[0]);
 
 if (!Number.isInteger(floor) || floor < 22) {
   console.error(`engines.node is "${declared}" — the floor may not go below 22`);
   process.exit(1);
 }
+
+if (currentMajor < 22) {
+  console.error([
+    "",
+    "ERROR: Node.js version incompatible",
+    `  Current: Node.js ${process.versions.node}`,
+    `  Required: Node.js 22 or later`,
+    "",
+    "This package requires an LTS version that still receives security patches.",
+    "Older Node.js versions (18, 20) are no longer supported.",
+    "",
+    "To upgrade Node.js:",
+    "  • Visit https://nodejs.org/ and download Node.js 22 LTS or newer",
+    "  • Or use a version manager (nvm, fnm, asdf, etc.)",
+    "",
+  ].join("\n"));
+  process.exit(1);
+}
